scope: All frozen FIT16 and INNER8, same sole clicks and candidate tapes as main MOT stage; failed initializations retained without replacement
risk_learned: Required subsequent branch using actual fresh FIT-only optimized current-write/recognition-risk head and INNER-only calibration, not historical writer reused as new fit
M_B: Only after actual TRAIN-qualified safe authority; memory has no authority permission in M-A
writes: Only actually globally committed current target UID; NEVER identity proposal UID if vetoed, no GT crop or extra click. MEAN is an explicitly unconstrained actual-commit diagnostic, not a safety claim.
scoring: Actual frozen common ACIB anchor/bank candidate-plus-NONE prediction captured before each current write; rank1 and proposed identity claim remain separate from C0 committed UID
current_commit_features: Actual probability/cosine/motion/native/global competition of committed current UID; raw GT labels never enter runtime
pending: Pending buffer never used as trusted identity bank; accepted current crop provenance retained
isolation_proof: FROZEN recomputes actual C0, all global outputs/export bytes match baseline; all changing memory variants also match FROZEN tensor-inclusive whole tracker fingerprints per original frame
metrics: Actual pinned full-video nine-metric TrackEval for all cases, exact equality with C0 required; identity recognition, nonzero writes, verified_OTHER/UNKNOWN write risk, correct retention, drift and rollback separately measured
offline_only_truth: Labels parsed only after full sequence runtime and all case SHA seals. UNKNOWN never called verified-other negative.
retention_denominator: All post-click non-NONE C0 committed crops strictly matched to clicked person, not just eligible high-confidence subset; eligible subset additionally reported if needed
recognition_denominators: Physical visibility and strict positive candidate existence reported separately; Rank1 among available positive candidates; competitive subset also reported
source_distribution: Own actual C0 committed state and changing own bank, never oracle identity history
